```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo=FALSE, warning=FALSE, message=FALSE)
```

`r params$report_note`

Generated: `r params$generated_at`

`r reporting_note()`

```{r notes, results='asis'}
for (name in names(params$extra_text_sections)) {
  cat("\n\n# ",name,"\n\n",sep="")
  values <- params$extra_text_sections[[name]]
  if (!length(values)) cat("No additional notes.\n") else {
    cat("\n\n",paste(values,collapse="\n\n"),"\n\n",sep="")
  }
}
```

```{r tables, results='asis'}
for (name in names(params$extra_tables)) {
  x <- params$extra_tables[[name]]
  cat("\n\n# ",name,"\n\n",sep="")
  if (!nrow(x) || !ncol(x)) {cat("No rows to report.\n");next}
  report_kable(x)
}
```

```{r figures, results='asis', fig.width=7, fig.height=5}
for (name in names(params$extra_plots)) {
  cat("\n\n# ",name,"\n\n",sep="")
  plot <- params$extra_plots[[name]]
  if(is.function(plot)) plot() else print(plot)
}
```
